title: Structural relaxation of Ti0.5Zr0.5NiSn primitive cell
action: Construct the 6-atom primitive cell of Ti0.5Zr0.5NiSn in space group P-4m2 (No. 115). Perform variable-cell relaxation using GGA-PBE DFT until forces are converged.
description: Relaxed crystal structure used as input for the subsequent electronic structure calculation.

title: Self-consistent field (SCF) calculation
action: Run a converged SCF calculation on the relaxed structure using a dense k-point mesh to obtain the ground-state charge density.
description: Ground-state charge density required for the non-self-consistent band structure calculation.

title: Band structure calculation and eigenvalue extraction
action: Perform a non-self-consistent band structure calculation along a high-symmetry path that includes Γ (k=(0,0,0)) and M (k=(0.5,0.5,0)). Extract the band eigenvalues, k-point coordinates, labels, and Fermi energy, and write the result to band_structure.json.
description: JSON file containing the band structure data from which the checker recomputes the direct band gap at Γ and the energy difference between conduction band edges at Γ and M.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: 'k_points' (array of objects, each with 'label' (string), 'k_coords' (list of 3 floats)), 'eigenvalues' (array of arrays, shape (n_bands, n_kpoints)), 'fermi_energy' (float).
